apple_listing.description:
Big life changes do not start big. They start with one small habit, done today, done again tomorrow. HabitKit turns those daily wins into a colorful grid of tiles, one square for every day you show up, so you can finally see yourself becoming the person you want to be.

That visible progress is the whole secret behind HabitKit, a beautifully simple habit tracker. When your grid looks this good, you will not want to stop. Fill the tiles, protect your streak, and let consistency do the heavy lifting.

Whether you want to work out more, read every night, meditate, drink more water, save money, or finally quit smoking, HabitKit gives every goal the same simple loop: do it, log it, watch the grid grow. No guilt trips, just daily habit tracking that feels rewarding.

BUILD GOOD HABITS, QUIT BAD ONES
Create the habits you want to grow, or flip it around and quit a habit: every day counts as clean until you log a slip, and your streak counts your clean days in a row. You can even set a daily maximum, like two coffees a day, and simply stay under it instead of going cold turkey.

TRACK YOUR HABITS YOUR WAY
Check a day off with a simple yes or no, count reps like glasses or pages, or measure amounts with your own unit, like 2 L of water or 7.5 km of running. Set daily goals and flexible schedules that fit your routine: every day, specific intervals, or a number of times per week or month.

YOUR PROGRESS AT A GLANCE
Every habit gets its own tile grid, like a contribution graph, and every completed day fills in a square. See all your habits together on one dashboard, switch between Classic, Compact, and Split views, and share a beautiful snapshot of your progress when you hit a milestone. One glance tells you the whole story: what you did, what you missed, and how far you have come.

WIDGETS FOR YOUR HOME SCREEN
Put your favorite habits right on your home screen with small, medium, and multi-habit widgets. Your grids stay in sight, so your goals stay on your mind. Widgets follow your theme too, all the way to pure black dark mode.

REMINDERS AT THE RIGHT TIME
Get a friendly nudge exactly when you need it, and never forget a habit again. Add a daily check-in to review your whole day, and with Pro, up to three reminders per habit.

STATISTICS, STREAKS, AND NOTES
Watch your current streak grow, chase your best streak, and set streak goals for extra motivation. Dive into completion statistics and monthly charts, manage past days in the calendar, and add a short note to any day: what went well, what got in the way.

MAKE IT YOURS
Give every habit its own color and icon, or use any emoji. Organize your dashboard with categories and filters, reorder everything with drag and drop, and pick light, dark, or system theme, including a pure black mode for OLED screens.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No sign-up. No ads. Your habit data stays on your device, and the app works completely offline.

HABITKIT PRO
HabitKit is free to use with up to four habits, including streaks, statistics, notes, and reminders. Pro unlocks unlimited habits, home screen widgets, import and export backups, restoring archived habits, and up to three reminders per habit. Subscribe monthly or yearly, or pay once and keep Pro forever with the lifetime option. Every upgrade supports an independent developer. Start free, see if the grid pulls you in, and upgrade whenever you are ready.

You do not need a new life. You need one small habit and a place to see it grow. Download HabitKit and place your first tile today.

apple_listing.releaseNotes:
Hello, sweet September! And sweet you, of course. While you were hopefully chasing waves, reaching new heights and exploring wild routes (or just staring at the sky, indulging in good old nothing), we were busy teaching Yorhart new tricks - the ones coming with iOS 27. So, grab that smoothie, and learn what’s new.

NEW
Siri As a Personal Health Guide
There are now two ways to make use of Siri in Gentler Streak. One is the use of App Intents, which make it possible to get information connected to your health and fitness without opening the app. The second is On-Screen Awareness, where Siri can help with additional context to what you are seeing on your screen.

App Intents
You can now ask Siri things like “what’s my activity status” or “show today’s workouts” without opening the app as long as you add the app’s name (Gentler Streak) to your prompt. A few office favorites to try:
- Today’s workouts (in Gentler Streak)?
- What’s my activity status (in Gentler Streak)?
- Today’s workout suggestions (in Gentler Streak)?
- Get today’s body metrics (in Gentler Streak)?
- How was my sleep last night (in Gentler Streak)?
- Start a workout on Apple Watch (in Gentler Streak)

On-Screen Awareness
Looking at workout data, accompanying charts and scratching your head a little? You can now ask Siri to explain what you are seeing. If there are parts of the app you would like to understand better, go to that feature, and ask Siri to tell you more: you could go from “summarize my workout” to “what’s this green strip on my screen” and Siri should explain it back to you. Play around to see what fits your usage best.

Heads up: if you are in the EU, or China, Siri AI has not been made available yet.

Refreshed Icons & Liquid Glass
New season comes with new trends. While we are all up for personal style, a little trendy touch-up can’t hurt.

Adaptive Layout
Gentler Streak can now fit any screen size, also the iPhone Duo when it comes out.

Personalized Workout Summary Suggestion
With a little help of on-device AI, we now try to give your afternoon walk, weekend ride, or yoga session some flavour. Workouts still come with default titles, but tap edit, and get prefilled text. Like it? Save it. Not feeling it? Create your own or keep the original, spartan version.

By releasing this (pretty) technical update, we will now fully focus our attention on where our hearts are - creating new functionalities that deepen personalized guidance. We are picking up our “how you feel” layer, which should see the light of day towards the end of October. Follow us on socials, for more info.

If you find Gentler Streak helpful, leaving a review on the App Store is literally one of the best (and fastest) ways to support our work. It gives us motivation, and helps others find us!

And now to you! Update, try it out, and let us know what you think - we read everything.

Email: support@gentlerstories.com
Reddit: r/gentlerstreakapp
Instagram: @gentlerstreak
Threads: @gentlerstreak

And as always, thank you for exploring your fitness with us!

apple_listing.description:
Willpower is not enough against social media algorithms!

That’s why I made one sec:

one sec adds friction to distracting apps to make them less appealing…long-term!

This principle works really well: we have gained scientific evidence in numerous research studies with the Max-Planck Institute, with the German and Danish government, and in dozens more scientific collaborations:

one sec has incredible effects on your screen time: app usage drops by 57% on average!

…just read our App Store reviews or try it for yourself if you don’t believe me (…you should really try it)!


How is one sec different from Screen Time limits or app blockers?
- one sec DELAYS access to distracting apps instead of blocking apps completely – that’s an important difference psychologically.
- This way, we solve the screen time problem at its roots: long-term & sustainably!
- one sec is always on, and makes using social media just slightly more annoying…so you’ll end up using it only when you actually have a reason!


Which apps can I use with one sec?
- You can set up one sec with any app you’d like to use less / more intentional.
- Most popular use-cases are: social media, games, video streaming, dating, stock/coin trading, adult content.
- Using one sec with one app of your choice if completely free, for more you’ll need to purchase one sec pro (we also need to finance development of our app!).

apple_listing.description:
AnkiMobile is a mobile companion to Anki®, a powerful, intelligent flashcard program that is free, multi-platform, and open-source. Sales of this app support the development of both the computer and mobile version, which is why the app is priced as a computer application.

AnkiMobile was written by the lead developer of Anki and AnkiWeb, and it has been around since 2010. Beware other apps using "Anki" in their name that have sprung up recently - they are not compatible with the rest of the Anki ecosystem, and they offer far fewer features, despite charging expensive subscriptions.

Some of AnkiMobile's features include:

- A free cloud synchronization service that lets you keep your card content synchronized across multiple mobile and computer devices. This makes it easy to add content on a computer and then study it on your mobile, easily keep your study progress current between an iPhone and iPad, and so on.
- The same SM2 and FSRS scheduling algorithms that the computer version of Anki uses, which remind you of material as you're about to forget it.
- A flexible interface designed for smooth and efficient study. You can set up AnkiMobile to perform different actions when you tap or swipe on various parts of the screen, and control which actions appear on the tool buttons.
- Comprehensive graphs and statistics about your studies.
- Support for large card decks - even 100,000+ cards.
- If your cards use images or audio clips, the media is stored on your device, so you can study without an internet connection.
- A powerful search facility that allows you to find cards that match criteria such as 'tagged high priority, answered in the last ten days and not containing the following words', and automatically place them into a deck to study.
- Support for displaying mathematical equations with MathJax, and rendering LaTeX created with the computer version.
- Support for adding images drawn with the Apple Pencil to your cards.

Please note that AnkiMobile is currently intended as a companion to the computer version of Anki, rather than a complete replacement for it. While AnkiMobile is able to display and schedule your cards in the same way the computer version does, certain changes like modifying note types need to be done with the computer software. Add-ons are not supported, so while you can study image occlusion cards created with the computer version, they can not be created within AnkiMobile. For this reason, please start with the computer version of Anki before you think about buying this app.

The cloud synchronization service is optional, and data can also be imported/exported from the app via a USB cable or AirDrop.

Like all apps, AnkiMobile can be purchased once and then used on multiple devices in a household using the same Apple ID. Family sharing is also supported (apart from in India). For information on bulk discounts for educational institutions, please see Apple's Volume Purchase Program.

For more information on AnkiMobile, including a link to the online manual, please have a look at the support page: https://docs.ankimobile.net/support.html. If you have any questions or want to report an issue, please let us know on our support site and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.
